mcqs.question: Under the Vanajeevi Didi initiative for women forest guardians in Palamau Tiger Reserve, what incentive was provided initially?
mcqs.explanation: The Vanajeevi Didi initiative provided an incentive of ₹3,000 per month initially for two months. The tempting alternative of ₹3,000 per month for six months is incorrect because the initial incentive period was only two months.
